articles.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

articles.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
articles.snippet: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax
articles.snippet: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.

articles.title: South Korean IPO slump adds to AI market jitters as Brent crude tops $111
articles.snippet: Elice’s debut slump added to concerns over AI infrastructure valuations, while rising oil prices compounded market uncertainty.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $82,000 as Nasdaq rebounds more than 1%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury company Strive continued to add large numbers of BTC to its balance sheet, while far larger peer Strategy acquired only a small amount.
